notes: Setup keeps one AI engine environment instead of two: about 1 GB smaller on Mac, about 8 GB smaller on Windows. The first launch after this update tidies up for a minute or two.
Hunyuan is the default translator. Gemma stays a choice if you download it.
The Dub Agent can now check your setup, change a stage's default, and download a model after asking you.
Update notices appear within seconds of launch and a downloaded update also applies when you quit (Mac).
The app reopens where you closed it, and your layout choices are remembered.
An install closed midway now resumes on the next launch.
